name: Hall Three-Repair Universality Seed
definition: Hall's 299-concept cornerless maximum class $C_H\subseteq Q_{12}$ together with the three absent repair tips $a_0=183$, $a_+=315$, and $a_-=1836$ in the standard binary-word encoding.
properties: Each one-tip extension is dismantlable ample. In zero-based coordinate numbering their pairwise distinct acquired supports are respectively $\{2,3,6,7\}$, $\{2,3,8,9\}$, and $\{4,5,10,11\}$. This triple realizes the hypotheses of the occurrence-row universality and reduced-base universality theorems.
